com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AIJudgeConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIConfig
      • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIJudgeConfig

  • public final class AIJudgeConfig
extends AIConfig
    A retrieved judge AI Config. This is the result of LDAIClient.judgeConfig(java.lang.String, com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext, com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIJudgeConfigDefault, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>).

    A judge config evaluates the output of another configuration; it carries the evaluation metric key it reports against. The messages have already had their templates interpolated. Instances are immutable.
